title: DuckNet backlog build — independent assessment
description: Output of the verify stage: a separate session that checks each candidate item against the code. merge-confidence.sh copies every field but id and rationale onto the item.

id.description: The candidate item's id. Exactly one assessment per item.

state.description: new: not in the code. partially-implemented: some of it exists. already-done: the code already satisfies the acceptance criteria. unfounded: the cited evidence does not hold.

confidence.description: Independent belief that this is real, correctly scoped, and worth filing as written.

rationale.description: One or two sentences naming what was checked and what was found.

evidence_checked.description: Paths actually opened while assessing this item.
